Name: NCA Essential Cybersecurity Controls (ECC) for OCI
Description: National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA) Essential Cybersecurity Controls (ECC-1:2018) for critical infrastructure and government cloud environments.

Requirements.Name: Cybersecurity Governance & Compartment Segmentation
Requirements.Description: Ensure logical separation of organizational environments across OCI compartments and avoid resources in root compartment.

Requirements.Name: Identity & Access Management Policy Enforcement
Requirements.Description: Mandate MFA, 14-character passwords, and 90-day rotation of API keys and auth tokens.

Requirements.Name: Network Traffic Filtering & Ingress Restrictions
Requirements.Description: Restrict internet exposure on administrative ports (SSH 22, RDP 3389) across all VCNs and subnets.

Requirements.Name: Data Protection and Cryptographic Key Security
Requirements.Description: Enforce customer-managed key encryption on block volumes, boot volumes, and object buckets with automatic key rotation.

Requirements.Name: Event Monitoring & 1-Year Audit Log Retention
Requirements.Description: Retain audit logs for at least 365 days and enable Cloud Guard threat monitoring across all compartments.
